test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a3ab773c630908c4d73148d772f163a2778b7c86b95605fe761399ab2a186b3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The elements at the corners interchange positions diagonally.

The center element rotates 90º clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d841165fb6e4355991aeac161e17776ae6391500b17716ff97c77d574824d6a.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements at the corners shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The center element rotates 90º clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99a448286744b2db326fa3426bc46f8582da2a02c6da2f2296ec5a660b0f83d0.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7faa7c8d4ba6bdef8149deb72722041d29003b146aaba76c288899e095be68c.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
